text: おん　さらさばていえい　そわか
meaning: The Japanese (Shingon) form of the Sanskrit "AUM Sarasvatyai svāhā": "AUM, to Sarasvati, so be it." Benzaiten is the Japanese form of Saraswati, goddess of music, eloquence and learning.
purpose: To ask for clear words, music and learning.
note: Benzaiten came to Japan with Buddhism and is honoured at Buddhist temples and Shinto shrines alike. Compare the Saraswati mantras in this library.
source: Shingon Buddhist practice, as printed in the Wikipedia article on Benzaiten
name: Benzaiten Mantra
